body.name: Sharp joint policy-mean set
body.construction: \(S(q)=\{(\mathbb E[\mathbf 1\{U\le p^\ell\}Y_1+\mathbf 1\{U>p^\ell\}Y_0])_{\ell=1}^L:U\sim\operatorname{Unif}[0,1],\ D=\mathbf 1\{U\le p_Z\},\ Y=DY_1+(1-D)Y_0,\ (U,Y_0,Y_1)\perp Z,\ \exists(V_0,V_1)\text{ satisfying existential rank similarity},\ \mathcal L(D,Y\mid Z)=q\}\)
